title: Know-It-All Brothers' House Back Wall
howToGet: At night as Child Link, check behind the Know-It-All Brothers' house in SW Kokiri Forest (tucked slightly deeper against the treehouse wall in Switch 2). Jump-slash it with your Kokiri Sword or a Deku Stick to grab the token.

title: Kokiri Shop Soft Soil Patch
howToGet: Drop Bottled Bugs onto the soft soil patch directly behind the Kokiri Shop during day or night.

title: House of Twins Roof
howToGet: At night as Adult Link, stand before the House of Twins in SE Kokiri Forest, Z/ZL-target the Gold Skulltula between the two roof peaks, and Hookshot it.

title: Lost Woods Bridge Clearing Soft Soil
howToGet: From Kokiri Forest entrance into Lost Woods, go Left, then Left again to the lower bridge area and release Bottled Bugs into the soft soil.

title: Lost Woods Forest Stage Soft Soil
howToGet: From Lost Woods entrance go Right, Left, Right, Left, Straight, Left to the butterfly clearing and drop Bottled Bugs into the soft soil.

title: Lost Woods Forest Stage High Ledge
howToGet: Plant a Magic Bean in the butterfly clearing soft soil as Child Link. Return at night as Adult Link and ride the flying leaf platform up to the upper ledge.

title: Sacred Forest Meadow Upper Hedge Wall
howToGet: Climb the ladder out of the Moblin hedge maze at night as Adult Link and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula high on the eastern stone wall.

title: East Hyrule Field Lone Tree
howToGet: Head to the lone glowing-cue tree in eastern Hyrule Field near the path to Kokiri Forest and roll into its trunk to knock down the Gold Skulltula.

title: Gerudo Valley Approach Fire/Cow Grotto
howToGet: Near the western bridge to Gerudo Valley, bomb the circle of small stones (or smash the boulder as Adult with Hammer + Fire Arrows), drop in, burn the spiderwebs with Din's Fire, and snag the token behind the cow with the Boomerang.

title: SE Peahat Wetland Cross-Era Grotto
howToGet: NEW IN SWITCH 2: Step 1 (Child Link): Bomb the cracked stone block in the SE marshy wetland area of Hyrule Field (near the Peahats), enter the grotto, read the Fairy's Thought wall message, and slay the ordinary Skullwalltula inside. Step 2 (Adult Link): Return to this same grotto in the future—a Gold Skulltula will have taken its place!

title: Lon Lon Ranch NE Tree Roll
howToGet: Roll into the lone tree in the northeast yard behind Talon's house (day or night) as Child Link.

title: Talon's House Upper Window
howToGet: At night as Child Link, look at the upper window on the racetrack-facing wall of Talon's house and use the Boomerang to kill the spider and pull the token.

title: Lon Lon Ranch SW Crumbling Shed Wall
howToGet: At night as Child Link, check high on the stone/brick wall of the southwest storage shed structure and use the Boomerang to retrieve the token.

title: Castle Town Guardhouse Crate
howToGet: Enter the Guardhouse (Lots O' Pots room right inside the Market drawbridge) as Child Link and roll into the corner wooden crate.

title: Hyrule Castle Path First Tree
howToGet: Climb over the vine gate into Hyrule Castle Grounds as Child Link and roll into the very first tree on the path.

title: Hyrule Castle Moat Song of Storms Grotto
howToGet: Play Song of Storms beside the tree near the northern Hyrule Castle moat corner to open a hidden grotto, bomb the fragile wall inside, and grab the high token with the Boomerang.

title: Outside Ganon's Castle Ruined Archway
howToGet: Enter Outside Ganon's Castle as Adult Link, turn around to look at the back of the ruined stone arch above the lava moat, and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula (day or night).

title: Kakariko Village Entrance Tree
howToGet: Roll into the lone tree near the center entrance of Kakariko Village as Child Link.

title: House of Skulltula Outer Wall
howToGet: At night as Child Link, check the exterior left/back wall of the House of Skulltula.

title: Kakariko Unfinished Brick Construction Pile
howToGet: At night as Child Link, slay the spider crawling directly on the stack of red bricks in the central construction site.

title: Kakariko Cucco Pen / Graveyard-Side House Wall
howToGet: At night as Child Link, check the back wall of the house bordering the Cucco pen on the path toward the Graveyard.

title: Kakariko Tall Watchtower Ladder
howToGet: At night as Child Link, shoot the Gold Skulltula high up on the wooden watchtower ladder with the Fairy Slingshot, then climb the ladder to grab the token.

title: Above Impa's House Rooftop Wall
howToGet: At night as Adult Link, Hookshot onto the Kakariko rooftop (where the man sits), then Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on the wall overlooking Impa's House.

title: Kakariko Graveyard Soft Soil Patch
howToGet: Drop Bottled Bugs onto the soft soil patch along the left cliff wall of Kakariko Graveyard.

title: Kakariko Graveyard East Wall
howToGet: At night as Child Link, face the south/east stone wall past the rows of graves and use the Boomerang to defeat the Skulltula and pull in the token.

title: Dodongo's Cavern Entrance Soft Soil
howToGet: Drop Bottled Bugs onto the soft soil patch immediately outside Dodongo's Cavern.

title: Death Mountain Trail Lower Bombable Alcove
howToGet: Just past the Kakariko gate on Death Mountain Trail, bomb the discolored brown rock wall on the right to uncover a hidden alcove and grab the token with the Boomerang (or Hookshot as Adult).

title: Trail Ledge Above Dodongo's Cavern Red Boulder
howToGet: At night as Adult Link, smash the reddish boulder on the cliff ledge overlooking Dodongo's Cavern with the Megaton Hammer to reveal a Gold Skulltula underneath.

title: Death Mountain Falling-Rocks Red Boulder
howToGet: At night as Adult Link, climb the upper volcanic rockfall path toward the summit and smash the isolated red boulder on the right side with the Megaton Hammer.

title: Goron City Top-Floor Boulder Maze Crate
howToGet: Enter the boulder-filled room on the top floor of Goron City as Child Link, blow through the gray boulders to the back-left corner, and roll into the wooden crate.

title: Goron City Suspended Central Platform
howToGet: Walk across the ropes to the suspended stone platform on the top floor of Goron City as Adult Link, check the back of the stone arch, and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula.

title: Death Mountain Crater Entrance Crate
howToGet: Step into Death Mountain Crater from the summit entrance and immediately roll into the wooden crate to the right before heat damage kicks in.

title: Death Mountain Crater Bolero Warp Soft Soil
howToGet: After learning Bolero of Fire as Adult Link, warp to Death Mountain Crater as Child Link and quickly drop Bottled Bugs into the soft soil beside the warp pad.

title: Zora's River Entrance Tree
howToGet: Roll into the lone tree right inside the Hyrule Field entrance to Zora's River as Child Link.

title: Zora's River Waterfall Ladder
howToGet: At night as Child Link, check the wooden ladder at the base of the Zora's Domain waterfall area, knock the spider off, and climb to collect the token.

title: Zora's River Upper Cliff Near Bridge
howToGet: At night as Adult Link, climb onto the high Fairy Grotto ledge halfway up Zora's River and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula high on the south canyon wall.

title: Zora's River High West Canyon Wall
howToGet: At night as Adult Link, walk onto the wooden bridge before the Zora's Domain waterfall, look high up on the left/west cliff wall, and Hookshot the token.

title: Zora's Domain Waterfall Cliff
howToGet: At night as Adult Link, stand at the top of the frozen (or thawed, post-Water Temple!) waterfall in Zora's Domain, look left, and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula.

title: Zora's Fountain SE Corner Tree
howToGet: Swim to the small island in the SE corner of Zora's Fountain (outside the Great Fairy boulder) as Child Link and roll into the tree.

title: Zora's Fountain Fallen Log Wall
howToGet: At night as Child Link, walk out onto the partially submerged fallen log in SW Zora's Fountain and use the Boomerang on the right stone wall.

title: Zora's Fountain Silver Gauntlets Secret Tunnel
howToGet: At night as Adult Link, lift the heavy gray boulder outside the Great Fairy Fountain in Zora's Fountain using the Silver Gauntlets, drop into the hidden tunnel, climb past the invisible Skulltulas, and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula at the ceiling.

title: Lake Hylia Fire-Arrow Island Pillar
howToGet: At night as Child Link, swim out to the small two-pillar island in southern Lake Hylia and slash the Gold Skulltula on the stone pillar.

title: Lakeside Laboratory Back Wall
howToGet: At night as Child Link, walk behind the Lakeside Laboratory and use the Boomerang to defeat the Skulltula and fetch the token.

title: Lakeside Laboratory Soft Soil Patch
howToGet: Release Bottled Bugs into the soft soil patch directly beside the Lakeside Laboratory.

title: Lakeside Laboratory Underwater Crate
howToGet: Sink to the bottom of the Lakeside Laboratory indoor pool with the Iron Boots as Adult Link, roll into the wooden crate, and Hookshot the revealed Gold Skulltula.

title: Lake Hylia Giant Dead Tree Crown
howToGet: At night as Adult Link, stand on the stone warp island above the Water Temple, aim the Longshot at the high trunk branch of the dead tree to grapple up, and slash the Gold Skulltula in the branches.

title: Gerudo Valley Entrance Small Waterfall
howToGet: At night as Child Link, stand on the wooden plank at the eastern entrance to Gerudo Valley and throw the Boomerang into the small rock cascade on the right.

title: Gerudo Valley Canyon Floor Soft Soil
howToGet: Cucco-glide down to the lower stone ledge next to the Cow at the bottom of Gerudo Valley canyon as Child Link and release Bottled Bugs into the soft soil.

title: Gerudo Valley Behind Carpenters' Tent
howToGet: Cross the Gerudo Valley bridge as Adult Link (via Epona or Longshot), check the canyon wall directly behind the Carpenters' Tent at night, and Hookshot it.

title: Gerudo Valley Stone Arch Pillar
howToGet: At night on the west side of Gerudo Valley as Adult Link, look across at the underside of the natural rock arch pillar and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula.

title: Gerudo's Fortress Upper Cliff Face
howToGet: Climb to the central exterior tier of Gerudo's Fortress at night as Adult Link and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula clinging to the upper rock face.

title: Horseback Archery Range North Target Pole
howToGet: Walk into the Horseback Archery Range east of Gerudo's Fortress at night and Hookshot the back of the northernmost wooden target post.

title: Haunted Wasteland Stone Poe Shelter
howToGet: Cross the River of Sand in Haunted Wasteland (using Longshot or Hover Boots), follow the flagpoles to the stone bunker in the sandstorm, climb down inside, and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on the wall.

title: Desert Colossus Spirit Temple Soft Soil
howToGet: Warp to Desert Colossus as Child Link using Requiem of Spirit and release Bottled Bugs into the soft soil beside the Spirit Temple entrance.

title: Desert Colossus Oasis Palm Tree
howToGet: Visit the dry/refilled oasis in southern Desert Colossus at night as Adult Link (play Song of Storms on the stone slab to fill the fairy oasis!) and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on the palm tree.

title: Desert Colossus Western Mesa Plateau
howToGet: Ride the Magic Bean leaf platform in Desert Colossus at night as Adult Link and hop off onto the flat stone mesa in the southwest half of the desert.

title: Deku Tree — 3F Compass Room Ledge
howToGet: Inside the 3F Compass room of the Great Deku Tree, climb the stone blocks on the left to slash the Gold Skulltula.

title: Deku Tree — B1 Sewer Grate
howToGet: Drop through the 1F center web to B1 and jump-slash the Gold Skulltula clinging to the metal grate by the water.

title: Deku Tree — B1 Basement Vines
howToGet: On B1 right near the torch switch, shoot the Gold Skulltula on the climbable vines with the Fairy Slingshot and climb up to grab the token.

title: Deku Tree — B1 Bombable Backtrack Room
howToGet: Return to B1 of the Great Deku Tree after getting Bombs and the Boomerang: burn the web behind the 3-Scrub room, crawl through, bomb the cracked stone wall on the far side, and Boomerang the high token.

title: Dodongo's Cavern — 1F East Corridor Baby Dodongo Bomb Wall
howToGet: In the 1F east corridor, lure a Baby Dodongo to explode next to the cracked side wall (or use a Bomb) and defeat the Gold Skulltula inside.

title: Dodongo's Cavern — 2F Vine Room Upper Alcove
howToGet: In theeast 1F/2F Baby Dodongo corridor, play Scarecrow's Song to summon Pierre on the high alcove and Hookshot up (or grab with Boomerang from exact angle as Child).

title: Dodongo's Cavern — 2F Tall Staircase Vines
howToGet: After bombing the Bomb Flower chain staircase to lower it, climb to the top and slash the Gold Skulltula on the upper vine wall.

title: Dodongo's Cavern — 1F North Armos Statue Bomb Room
howToGet: Just before the boss area on 1F/2F north, bomb the cracked wall behind the lone Armos statue and slay the spider inside.

title: Dodongo's Cavern — 1F Giant Pillar Room Backtrack Alcove
howToGet: In the room with rising fire pillars (1F west), backtrack as Adult Link—or drop from 2F past the block puzzle—and Hookshot into the high side alcove behind the Armos.

title: Jabu-Jabu's Belly — B1 Rising Water Room Vines
howToGet: Hit the ceiling switch to raise the water in the B1 Ruto pit corridor and grab the Gold Skulltula on the vine wall (or use Boomerang).

title: Jabu-Jabu's Belly — B1 Bottom Pit Wall #1
howToGet: Where Princess Ruto drops to B1 near the Zora's Sapphire, use the Boomerang to snag the first Gold Skulltula on the fleshy wall.

title: Jabu-Jabu's Belly — B1 Bottom Pit Wall #2
howToGet: Right beside #67 in the B1 lower pit room, use the Boomerang to snag the second Gold Skulltula high on the wall.

title: Jabu-Jabu's Belly — 1F Pre-Boss Vine Climb
howToGet: In the final room before Barinade, stun the jellyfish switch with a crate, climb the vines, and Boomerang the Gold Skulltula through the web gap.

title: Forest Temple — 1F Entrance Courtyard Vines
howToGet: Right inside the first Wolfos entrance hall of the Forest Temple, climb the right-hand vines (or Hookshot) to grab the Gold Skulltula.

title: Forest Temple — 1F Central Hall North Stairs
howToGet: In the main 4-torch central chamber, walk up the north stairs and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula to the right of the doorway.

title: Forest Temple — 1F NE Courtyard Island Arch
howToGet: From the upper balcony of the NE outdoor courtyard, Hookshot the chest on the stone island, then Hookshot the Gold Skulltula across the stream.

title: Forest Temple — 1F NW Courtyard Raised Pillar
howToGet: Step out onto the upper stone walkway of the NW outdoor courtyard (via the twisted hallway) and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula behind the hearts pillar.

title: Forest Temple — B2 Rotating Pre-Boss Chamber
howToGet: Ride the central elevator down to B2 before Phantom Ganon and rotate the outer walls until the alcove hiding the 5th Gold Skulltula opens.

title: Fire Temple — 1F Song of Time Tile Room
howToGet: Across the 1F lava bridge room, play the Song of Time to move the blue block, enter the Like-Like/Tile upper door, and Hookshot the Skulltula.

title: Fire Temple — 3F Rolling Boulder Maze Bomb Wall
howToGet: On the ground floor of the 3F rolling boulder maze, bomb the hollow-sounding flat stone wall along the eastern corridor.

title: Fire Temple — 4F Scarecrow Secret Climb #1
howToGet: Atop the 3F boulder maze, play Scarecrow's Song to summon Pierre on the high 4F ledge, Hookshot up, ride the chain elevator to 5F, and slash the Skulltula on the climbable grate.

title: Fire Temple — 5F Scarecrow Circular Room #2
howToGet: Continue right past #77 into the circular 5F bonus room and grab the Gold Skulltula high on the stone wall near the 200-Rupee chest.

title: Fire Temple — 1F Entrance Totem Hammer Room
howToGet: After obtaining the Megaton Hammer, smash the stone totem blocking the left door in the 1F entrance staircase hall and clear the mini-rooms to the Skulltula.

title: Ice Cavern — Spinning Ice Blade Room
howToGet: In the first large hall with spinning ice blades and Silver Rupees, Hookshot the Gold Skulltula nestled among the icicles on the east wall.

title: Ice Cavern — Compass / Blue Fire Alcove
howToGet: Melt the red ice blocking the east side room to get the Compass and Blue Fire, then Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on the icy wall. (Note: the old Red Ice Heart Piece in this room was removed in Switch 2!)

title: Ice Cavern — Sliding Ice Block Puzzle Room
howToGet: In the large western ice-block pushing puzzle room, Hookshot the Gold Skulltula high up on the western wall.

title: Water Temple — B1 South Bombable Grate
howToGet: With water drained to 1F, bomb the cracked floor in the 1F south corridor, swim under, use Spin Attack / Din's Fire to open the gate, and slash the Skulltula.

title: Water Temple — 3F Central Pillar Interior
howToGet: Inside the central tower of the Water Temple, raise water to 2F and use the Longshot (not regular Hookshot!) to reach the Gold Skulltula near the ceiling.

title: Water Temple — 2F Moving Platform Chasm
howToGet: En route to Dark Link / Longshot (or right after grabbing Longshot), Longshot the Gold Skulltula high on the far right wall of the moving-platform waterfall room.

title: Water Temple — B1 Whirlpool River Grate
howToGet: Behind the Dark Link / Longshot room in the underground river with whirlpools, sink with Iron Boots and Longshot the Skulltula on the metal wall grate.

title: Water Temple — 1F Falling Boulders Waterfall
howToGet: On 1F north en route to the Boss Key, stand in the water channel where boulders cascade down and Longshot the Gold Skulltula high on the waterfall wall.

title: Bottom of the Well — West Inner Door (Like-Like)
howToGet: Unlock the west door of the inner square corridor inside Bottom of the Well with a Small Key and Boomerang the Skulltula past the invisible pit.

title: Bottom of the Well — East Inner Door
howToGet: Unlock the east door of the inner square corridor with a Small Key and Boomerang the Gold Skulltula on the wall.

title: Bottom of the Well — NE Like-Like Cage
howToGet: Crawl into the NE maze from the outer ring, navigate past the Fire Keese and Like-Like into the locked cell room, and grab the Gold Skulltula.

title: Shadow Temple — B2 Invisible Spinning Scythe Room
howToGet: Defeat the Keese and Silver Blade trap in the side room off the giant chasm to open the barred cell holding this Gold Skulltula.

title: Shadow Temple — B3 Falling Spike Ceiling Cell
howToGet: In the B3 room with falling spiked ceilings, Hookshot the Gold Skulltula inside the left-hand iron cell.

title: Shadow Temple — B3 Single Flaming Skull Pot
howToGet: In the side room with a single giant flaming skull pot (toss a Bomb inside for a Small Key!), Hookshot the Gold Skulltula behind the pot.

title: Shadow Temple — B4 Phantom Ship Scarecrow Ledge
howToGet: Before boarding the Phantom Ship on B4, play the Scarecrow's Song on the dock to summon Pierre high on the left ledge and Longshot across.

title: Shadow Temple — B4 Three Spinning Flaming Skulls
howToGet: After disembarking the Phantom Ship, enter the room with three spinning skull statues and Longshot the Gold Skulltula behind them.

title: Spirit Temple — 1F Child Metal Fence
howToGet: In the Child wing 1F room after defeating the Stalfos/Keese across the pit, throw the Boomerang through the metal fence to grab the token.

title: Spirit Temple — 1F/2F Child Sun Block Climb
howToGet: In the tall vertical climb shaft leading up to the 2F Lizardfos/Sun Block hall as Child Link, Boomerang the Skulltula on the opposite brick wall.

title: Spirit Temple — 2F Pre-Iron Knuckle Hall
howToGet: Just above the stairs before the Child Iron Knuckle mini-boss room, Boomerang the Gold Skulltula high above the doorway.

title: Spirit Temple — 1F Adult Rolling Boulder Song of Time Room
howToGet: In the Adult wing 1F boulder-dodging Silver Rupee room, play the Song of Time to move the blue block and Hookshot the Skulltula inside the niche.

title: Spirit Temple — 3F Main Colossus Statue Scarecrow Ledge
howToGet: In the grand central statue chamber of the Spirit Temple, stand on the west 3F hand/ledge, play Scarecrow's Song to summon Pierre on the opposite high alcove, and Longshot over.
